_meta.run: design-critic prompt (.claude/agents/design-critic.md) executed by a Sonnet general-purpose subagent (the custom agent is not registered mid-session); blind: sheet + metrics only; design-1 = Adam CAD v0 meshes, design-2 = sample_sleek_050 smooth massing

reads_as_reason: The form is adult and smooth, but it is a single undifferentiated clay body: no seams, no joint recesses, no visor or face detail, so it looks like an artist mannequin rather than a finished product.

G1.evidence: Human proportions with a small egg-shaped head, a visible neck and a tapered torso. No chibi head and no box torso, so it does not read as a toy or character. The mannequin look is a G2/G3 problem.

G2.evidence: Chest, waist and pelvis, and thigh and shank, flow continuously, but there are no deliberate dark recesses at the shoulder, elbow, hip, knee or ankle; the arms hang as smooth tubes.

G3.evidence: The clay render cannot show colour; geometrically there are no seams, gaps or inset zones where a dark under-structure or accent could appear.

G4.evidence: Rounded-oval sections and soft radii used consistently across head, torso, arms, legs and feet; shoulder caps slightly squarer.

G6.evidence: In the equal-height lineup, head size, shoulder cap, arm length and leg length match the references (IoU 0.756 / 0.775). Differences: pelvis/thigh flare more, waist pinches more, head is a plain egg, arms angle outward.

pairwise.evidence: Image A (baseline) has a box torso, rectangular shoulder blocks, stacked cuboid limbs, visible horizontal ledges and gaps, and a neck stalk, so it reads as a toy. Image B (candidate) has continuous curvature, a flowing silhouette and human proportions close to the references, and none of those toy cues. Image A has more mechanical interest, but it fails the sleek, calm, premium brief outright.

top_changes.change: Add deliberate joint recesses: a short narrower station at the shoulder-to-upper-arm, elbow, hip-to-thigh and knee junctions (the dark-material zones).
top_changes.profile_param: segments[arm_l/arm_r].stations[elbow].w (reduce 15-20% over a short z span); segments[leg_l/leg_r].stations[knee].w and .d

top_changes.change: Give the head a defined visor: flatten and slightly widen the face zone so a glossy dark face plate can be assigned.
Reduce the hip and thigh flare (hourglass read); bring the arms in closer to the torso.

notes: Station and segment names in top_changes are best guesses and must be matched to the real ids. The visual FAIL on G2 is not a numeric disagreement: the numeric set has no recess criterion.
